rewrites.comment: Client-side routing. React Router owns every path, but the browser asks the server for /reports/performance first — without this rewrite a refresh or a pasted deep link 404s, because no such file exists on disk.

headers.comment: Hashed asset filenames change whenever their content does, so they are safe to cache permanently.
index.html must never be cached — it is the file that points at the current asset hashes, so a stale copy pins users to a deleted build.
This panel handles money and credentials and is never meant to be framed.
